NB3: sudden or severe chest pain; r4 weak (can be muscular) → emergency.check

NB3: 'cannot speak' only together with a breathing word

NB3: whole blood forms; review r3 B1: not with nose words (nosebleed)

lips / tongue / mouth swelling without a trigger: r4 weak → emergency.check; not after an injury
lips / tongue / mouth swelling with a trigger, suddenly or with breathing words: strong
face and lips together: strong

NB3: throat swelling only with a trigger or a breathing word (not a sore throat)
D28 / DN-11: NHS 'sudden swelling of the face, hands or feet'
